analysis: The code uses try-with-resources for MemoryWorkspace, then evaluates items.size() > 1. Additionally, multiple calls to Nd4j.createFromArray in the if branch may throw IndexOutOfBoundsException or NullPointerException if input arrays are malformed (call 6).
